content:
We use the unique representation \(B=2c^2\), since \(B\) must have odd exponent of 2 and all other prime exponents even.

For \(B\) to be three-digit:
\[
100 \le 2c^2 \le 999
\]
\[
50 \le c^2 \le 499.5
\]
Thus
\[
8 \le c \le 22
\]
because \(\lceil \sqrt{50}\rceil=8\) and \(\lfloor \sqrt{499.5}\rfloor=22\).

There are \(22-8+1=15\) such integers \(c\), hence 15 such numbers \(B\).

\[
\boxed{15}
\]
